Find more details about our encoders in our blog post. 💻 Demos: Try this fine-tuned model running in a CPU-only Hugging Face space: PII detection — spot and remove 40 kinds of personal information across 16 languages.

sources.title: LFM2.5-Encoder-350M - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: At 350M parameters, it is the larger sibling in the encoder family, built for maximum downstream quality when fine-tuned into task-specific models (classification, token classification, retrieval, reranking, and semantic similarity) across 15 languages. HF Use LFM2.5-Encoder-350M when downstream quality matters most.
